question: List the first five artist names alphabetically.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name LIMIT 5

question: How many albums are in the catalog?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Albums FROM Album

question: Show track names priced above 1.00, ordered by name.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice > 1 ORDER BY Name

question: List distinct customer countries alphabetically.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer ORDER BY Country

question: Show employee names and titles sorted by employee ID.
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Title FROM Employee ORDER BY EmployeeId

question: Which invoices have a total greater than 20, ordered by invoice ID?
sql: SELECT InvoiceId, Total FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 20 ORDER BY InvoiceId

question: Count tracks for each media type, including empty media types, ordered by media type ID.
sql: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS Tracks FROM MediaType m LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId=m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId,m.Name ORDER BY m.MediaTypeId

question: Show album titles with their artist names, sorted by album ID.
sql: SELECT a.Title,r.Name FROM Album a JOIN Artist r ON a.ArtistId=r.ArtistId ORDER BY a.AlbumId

question: Count customers per country, ordered by country.
sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY Country

question: What is the average track duration in milliseconds?
sql: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) AS AverageDuration FROM Track

question: Show total invoice revenue by billing country, ordered by country.
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY BillingCountry

question: List track names and genre names for genre ID 1, ordered by track ID.
sql: SELECT t.Name,g.Name AS Genre FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId=g.GenreId WHERE g.GenreId=1 ORDER BY t.TrackId

question: List invoice IDs issued during calendar year 2010, ordered by ID.
sql: SELECT InvoiceId FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2011-01-01' ORDER BY InvoiceId

question: Which customer IDs have never placed an invoice, sorted ascending?
sql: SELECT CustomerId FROM Customer WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Invoice i WHERE i.CustomerId=Customer.CustomerId) ORDER BY CustomerId

question: Find the three longest tracks; break duration ties by track ID ascending.
sql: SELECT TrackId,Name,Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC,TrackId LIMIT 3

question: Show playlist names and their track counts including empty playlists, ordered by playlist ID.
sql: SELECT p.Name,COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS Tracks FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId=pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId,p.Name ORDER BY p.PlaylistId

question: What is the total quantity of tracks sold?
sql: SELECT SUM(Quantity) AS Units FROM InvoiceLine

question: List customer IDs whose invoices sum to over 40, ordered by ID.
sql: SELECT CustomerId,SUM(Total) AS Spend FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total)>40 ORDER BY CustomerId

question: Show track names containing the word love as a substring, case insensitive, sorted by track ID.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE LOWER(Name) LIKE '%love%' ORDER BY TrackId

question: List direct reports of employee ID 2 by employee ID.
sql: SELECT EmployeeId,FirstName,LastName FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo=2 ORDER BY EmployeeId

question: For each album, show minimum catalog track price, sorted by album ID.
sql: SELECT AlbumId,MIN(UnitPrice) AS MinimumPrice FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId ORDER BY AlbumId

question: Which tracks are not in any playlist? Return IDs ascending.
sql: SELECT TrackId FROM Track WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PlaylistTrack p WHERE p.TrackId=Track.TrackId) ORDER BY TrackId

question: Show average invoice total by calendar year, sorted by year.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y',InvoiceDate) AS Year,AVG(Total) AS AverageTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year

question: Show the five genres with greatest sold quantity; break ties by genre ID.
sql: SELECT g.GenreId,g.Name,SUM(l.Quantity) AS Units FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId=g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine l ON l.TrackId=t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId,g.Name ORDER BY Units DESC,g.GenreId LIMIT 5

question: For each support representative, count assigned customers including zero, sorted by employee ID.
sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId,COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS Customers FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId=e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY e.EmployeeId

question: List albums with more than 15 tracks, ordered by album ID.
sql: SELECT AlbumId,COUNT(*) AS Tracks FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*)>15 ORDER BY AlbumId

question: Find customers spending above the mean of customer spending totals; return customer ID and spend sorted by ID.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT CustomerId,SUM(Total) Spend FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) SELECT CustomerId,Spend FROM s WHERE Spend>(SELECT AVG(Spend) FROM s) ORDER BY CustomerId

question: Return track ID and revenue for each sold track, sorted by ID.
sql: SELECT TrackId,SUM(UnitPrice*Quantity) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY TrackId ORDER BY TrackId

question: Show customer IDs and their latest invoice date, sorted by customer ID.
sql: SELECT CustomerId,MAX(InvoiceDate) AS Latest FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId ORDER BY CustomerId

question: Show artists without albums, sorted by artist ID.
sql: SELECT ArtistId,Name FROM Artist WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Album a WHERE a.ArtistId=Artist.ArtistId) ORDER BY ArtistId
